name: Demon, Godslayer Glabrezu
source: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary
book: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary

facets.bk: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary

body:
This immense beast stands on two hoofed legs. Four monstrous arms stretch high over its shoulders, each ending in sharp claws and pincers.

Godslayer Glabrezu Demon CR 19

XP 204,800
Combat (barbaric)
CE Huge outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +22

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 11, flat-footed 31 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +23 natural, -2 size)
hp 351 (18d12+234)
Fort +24, Ref +13, Will +15
DR 10/epic and good; Immune electricity, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10, fire 10; SR 30

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 claws +29 (1d8+13/19-20), 2 pincers +27 (2d6+6), bite +29 (2d6+13)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks death throes (95 points of piercing damage, Reflex DC 32 for half), dismantle armor, smite good (7/day, +6 to hit, +18 damage)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 18th, concentration +25)

At will–greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)

STATISTICS

Str 37, Dex 15, Con 36, Int 13, Wis 28, Cha 22
Base Atk +18; CMB +33; CMD 46
Feats Dimensional Agility, Dimensional Assault, Dimensional Dervish, Dodge, Improved Critical (claws), Improved Initiative, Multiattack, Mythic Companion, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +15, Climb +17, Intimidate +22, Knowledge (local) +5, Knowledge (religion) +10, Perception +22, Survival +20, Swim +21
Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic; telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dismantle Armor (Ex)

If the godslayer glabrezu hits a foe with two claw attacks, it can attempt to peel away the target’s armor and shield as a free action by making a CMB check. If the outsider is successful, the target’s armor and shield are torn from his body and dismantled, falling to the ground. Armor subjected to this attack loses half its hit points and gains the broken condition if the target fails a DC 32 Reflex save. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Teleport (Ex)

The godslayer glabrezu’s ability to greater teleport at will counts as the dimension door spell for the purposes of the Dimensional Agility, Dimensional Assault, and Dimensional Dervish feats.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (abyss)
Organization solitary, pair, or gang (3 6)
Treasure double normal

While the physical characteristics and natural weapons of godslayers vary, they generally retain some combination of smaller and larger arms. Most godslayers stand 24 feet tall and weigh 8,000 pounds.

Though the common glabrezu seems an unlikely champion for the armies of demonkind, few demons can match their petty jealousy and desire for deicide. When obsessively focused on the death of a powerful entity, the demon dedicates itself completely to its quarry. It develops a true and passionate hate, plotting against the target’s agents or setting traps to dismantle its support. The glabrezu then strikes when its target grows weakest, and are disturbingly cunning in orchestrating the perfect assassination. Each godslayer’s approach to the murder of their prey reflects the nature of their subject, with the godslayer presented here seeks to murder a slow-moving shield-bearing dwarven avatar of protection.
